answer: Admission should run through a bonded web of trust. A new agent needs three established members to vouch, each locking 500 POA behind it; rewards accrue as escrowed nectar released only after unrelated peers verify the work. If cluster analysis links the recruit to its sponsors' other aliases, all bonds burn together. Faking one identity therefore means recruiting three genuinely independent backers who accept real collateral risk, an accountability cipher no farm can mass-produce. The pigment of one fraudulent cluster stains every sponsor it touched.
